_comment: Curated voice catalogue. Each entry maps a stable 'id' to a Piper voice model. Ids are a durable contract - the APU stores the selected id in its settings table - so never rename one after release; add a new entry instead. To add a voice: copy an entry, set a unique id, fill model/config/model_url/config_url from https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices, then run `syscon-tts download-voices <id>`. A site that does not want to edit this file can point SYSCON_TTS_EXTRA_MANIFEST at its own JSON (same shape) to add or replace entries, or simply drop the .onnx and .onnx.json into the voices directory, where they are discovered automatically.
_licensing: PlantStar ships to paying customers, so this catalogue only includes voices whose model card states a license permitting commercial use (public domain, CC0, Unlicense, CC BY). 'license' records what the upstream MODEL_CARD says; anything else is reported by `syscon-tts doctor` as needing review and is skipped by a bulk `download-voices`. Voices deliberately NOT catalogued: en_US-ryan, en_US-hfc_female, en_US-hfc_male and zh_CN-xiao_ya (CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial); en_US-amy, en_GB-alan and en_US-lessac (license stated only as 'see dataset URL', unverified); zh_CN-chaowen (CC0 dataset but finetuned from the non-commercial xiao_ya). Any of them can still be used by a site that has cleared it - see DEPLOY.md.
_quality: x_low (smallest/fastest) < low < medium (balanced; the APU default) < high (largest/slowest). Medium models are roughly 60 MB on disk and in RSS.

voices.name: Huayan - Mandarin Chinese
voices.notes: The only Mandarin voice Piper 1.2 can run whose license is not explicitly non-commercial - but its model card states the dataset license as 'Unknown', so it needs legal sign-off before it goes to a customer. Serves both zh-Hans and zh-Hant sites: the spoken language is the same, only the script differs. Spot-check Traditional text before promising it.
